messages:
maria: hey folks — opened PR #1987 that switches the 13B inference path to a 4-bit quant profile + tweaks prefix KV caching policy. can someone eyeball perf vs cost tradeoffs? pinging @jonah @sam for perf and cache routing checks.

jonah: looking now. do you have a quick summary of p50/p95 and tokens/sec for the benchmark you ran? also which HW?

maria: ran on p4d-ish perf pool (8xA100-ish sim). locally measured: p50=110ms -> now 95ms after the quant change, p95=320ms -> 290ms. tokens/sec increased ~12%. cost/unit token estimate down ~18%. full numbers in the gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/bench-pr1987

sam: quick skim — nice. one question: the cache policy change reduces prefix retention from 4k->2k tokens for the 13B profile, right? whats the eviction signal?

maria: correct. eviction uses the workload-aware score: recency + decay factor. config snippet in PR: ```yaml
model_profiles:
  llama-13b:
    quant: q4_k_mixed
    kv_cache_retention: 2048
    cache_eviction:
      strategy: workload_score
      decay: 0.6
```

olga: small concern — for multi-turn assistants we might see more cache misses with 2k retention. did you run multi-turn latency regressions?

maria: ran a 10k convo simulation set — end-to-end latency p50 regressed ~+5ms, p95 unchanged. allocation usage dropped 22% which is the biggest cost win. i can attach the full sim results in the PR.

jonah: thanks. two things i want checked before approving: (1) perf test under synthetic worst-case (long context) to ensure kv eviction doesn't thrash, (2) a fallback routing policy to a slightly larger model variant if cold-cache latency crosses threshold.

sam: +1 on fallback routing. also can we add a unit test for the eviction score math? small test to pin behavior.

maria: noted — added TODOs in the PR. i pushed one more commit with the eviction unit test and a canary routing rule: ```json
{"route":"/chat","fallback_model":"llama-13b-std","threshold_ms":500}```

deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled for pr-1987 to canary pool tomorrow 03:00 UTC. tag: canary/1987.

olga: if canary looks stable i'm fine with merge. please include the bench artifacts in the PR so SRE can validate cost math.

jonah: i'll run the synthetic worst-case today and post results in the PR. expect comments in ~2-3h.

maria: thanks everyone — will update PR with artifacts and the minor test. if jonah gives green, i'll merge and kick the canary as scheduled. :thumbsup:
